verdict.rationale: Linear documents identity-based access control (Okta SSO applying existing Linear permissions, centralized admin access management) and private/sub-team visibility restrictions for sensitive work, plus admin approval of third-party apps — all pointing to some role/access control. However there is no evidence of granular, per-item view/edit permission assignment (e.g., custom roles, field-level or issue-level edit restrictions) that a PM could configure themselves. Missing for 10: documentation of custom roles beyond admin/member, granular view-vs-edit permission settings per issue/project, and independent verification of these controls in practice.
